question: Within 160 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant along the travel direction from Salus University, Elkins Park, PA to Manton Green, Philadelphia, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.129394 40.086172)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.172048 39.935946)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.129394 40.086172)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.129394 40.086172)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.description: Accepts orders via text before 11:45 AM.
